verdict: Bunge's sales rose 7% to $23.8B on its bigger post-Viterra network, and profit nearly doubled to $318M as soybean and softseed processing results improved.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: continuing operations, vs $0.86 a year ago

kpis.label: EPS (adjusted)
kpis.note: excludes mark-to-market timing and certain charges

segments.name: Soybean Processing and Refining
segments.note: Crushing soybeans into meal and oil and refining it — the largest business, up 5%, with segment EBIT up to $547M from $337M on stronger processing results in North America, Argentina, Brazil and Europe.

segments.name: Softseed Processing and Refining
segments.note: Canola, sunflower and other softseeds — up 18% as processing volumes rose in every region; segment EBIT rose to $353M from $236M.

segments.name: Tropical Oils and Specialty Ingredients
segments.note: Palm and other tropical oils and specialty food ingredients — up 7%, though segment EBIT fell to $13M from $77M.

segments.name: Grain Merchandising and Milling
segments.note: Buying, moving and milling grains and sugar around the world — sales up 5%, but the segment lost $74M at the EBIT line after $82M of charges on the sale of two Brazilian sugarcane mills.

segments.name: Corporate and Other
segments.note: Almost no outside sales — corporate activities sit here. A rounding-sized slice of revenue.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative expenses
opex.note: Running the global network — down from $678M a year ago, which carried heavier Viterra combination costs.

opex.name: Foreign exchange losses, net
opex.note: Currency moves on cross-border grain trade — a $63M loss in the quarter.

otherDetail: Other income of $17M and $22M of income from affiliates, less $36M of EBIT attributable to noncontrolling interests and $188M of net interest expense (interest expense of $208M less $20M of interest income), plus $7M of noncontrolling share of interest and tax — a net $178M cost.
oneTimers: $82M of charges in Grain Merchandising and Milling tied to the announced sale of two Brazilian sugarcane mills — $66M of impairment charges and $16M of hedge losses, recorded in cost of goods sold.
Viterra acquisition and integration costs in Corporate and Other reduced net income by $21M in the quarter (spread across cost of goods sold, SG&A, interest and tax).
Adjusted EPS of $2.56 excludes $0.28 per share of mark-to-market timing differences and $0.64 of certain gains and charges; GAAP EPS was $1.64.

takeaways.title: Soybean processing drove the quarter
takeaways.text: Soybean Processing and Refining EBIT rose to $547M from $337M, and Softseed EBIT to $353M from $236M — processing margins, helped by the expanded Viterra network, did the heavy lifting.

takeaways.title: Adjusted profit is well above GAAP
takeaways.text: Adjusted EPS was $2.56 vs GAAP $1.64. The gap is $0.28 of mark-to-market timing — paper swings on commodity contracts that reverse later — and $0.64 of certain charges, including the Brazil mill sale.

takeaways.title: Grain merchandising lost money
takeaways.text: Grain Merchandising and Milling posted a $74M EBIT loss despite $6.76B of sales, after the $82M Brazil sugarcane-mill charges. Excluding certain charges, its adjusted EBIT was $87M.

footerNote: Bunge reports Total EBIT of $667M. This page's operating step is $664M — gross profit less SG&A and foreign-exchange losses; the $3M difference (other income and affiliate income, less the share attributable to noncontrolling interests) is grouped in Other below it, so the page still ties exactly to reported net income of $318M.
